verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's Harvest API lets an AI-native integrator update candidates, advance/move/reject applications, and add attachments, and its sourcing suite lists explicit 'Bulk outreach campaigns' at scale — this implies bulk-style automation is possible, but there is no documented dedicated bulk/batch endpoint (e.g., batch update multiple candidates in one call) and probes for the OpenAPI spec 404, so true multi-item bulk semantics aren't clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or SDK methods for operating on many records in a single call, and independent confirmation of bulk semantics beyond marketing copy.
